Here are some practical tips to identify and prevent phishing attacks:

**How to Identify Phishing Attempts:**
• Check the sender's email address carefully - look for slight misspellings or unusual domains
• Hover over links before clicking to see the actual URL destination
• Look for urgent language demanding immediate action ("Your account will be closed!")
• Watch for poor grammar, spelling mistakes, or unprofessional formatting
• Be suspicious of unexpected attachments or requests for sensitive information

**Prevention Strategies:**
• Enable two-factor authentication (2FA) on all important accounts
• Keep your software and antivirus updated
• Use unique, strong passwords for each account
• Verify requests for sensitive information through alternate communication channels
• Report suspected phishing emails to your IT department or email provider
• Regularly backup important data
• Educate yourself and colleagues about common phishing tactics

Remember: When in doubt, don't click! It's always better to verify through official channels than to risk compromising your security.
